children: Jason V. Coloma, a Director and Chief Executive Officer, reported sales of Maze Therapeutics common stock to satisfy tax withholding on vested restricted stock units. The transactions were executed at weighted average prices of $26.376, $27.1211 and $26.0133 per share (multiple transactions within these ranges). The total proceeds from the sales were $593,954. Following the reported transactions, Coloma directly owns 27,362 shares and indirectly owns 241,506 shares via family trusts.

title: Maze Therapeutics Chief Executive Officer Sold Shares Worth Over $593K
